info.title: Chat API
info.description: REST API for the chat application. Provides endpoints for theme configuration, authentication, and management. All endpoints return appropriate HTTP status codes (200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 502, 503) with descriptive error messages.

tags.name: chat
tags.description: Chat completion proxy to DIAL Core

tags.name: rate
tags.description: Submit assistant message ratings to DIAL Core

tags.name: deployments
tags.description: List deployments available to the authenticated user

id.description: Unique stable identifier from DIAL Core

displayName.description: Display name, falls back to id when absent

interfaces.description: Interface types supported by this deployment

applicationTypeSchemaId.description: Application type schema id from DIAL Core (present only for application deployments)

inputAttachmentTypes.description: Accepted MIME types for input attachments from DIAL Core (e.g. ["audio/*", "image/*"])

properties.description: Named configuration properties supported by this deployment

isChatMessageInputDisabled.description: When true, the application does not accept free-form text input; users interact only via form/action buttons.

description.example: A multimodal model combining reasoning and efficiency.

url.description: Remote URL of the attachment content

reference_type.description: MIME type of the reference resource

attachments.description: DIAL API attachments to include with the message

form_value.description: Key-value map of form field values submitted via an embedded form widget.

content.example: Hello, how can you help me today?

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the message was created

custom_content.description: Extra DIAL payload attached to the message

messages.description: Ordered chat messages to send to DIAL Core

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

firstMessage.description: The first message to start the conversation. May be empty when custom_content carries attachments, form_value, or configuration_value.
firstMessage.example: Hello, how can you help me today?

deploymentId.description: ID of the catalog item (model or application) to use for this conversation

custom_content.description: Extra DIAL payload attached to the first user message

id.description: Full DIAL Core resource URL used as the stable conversation identifier.

title.description: Human-readable conversation title (the resource `name` from DIAL Core).

updatedAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the last update.

sharedWithMe.description: True when this conversation was shared with the current user by another user.

publishedWithMe.description: True when this conversation was published to the organisation and is visible to the current user.

isPinned.description: True when the user has pinned this conversation.

nextToken.description: Cursor for the next page. Present only when more results exist. Pass as `nextToken` in the next request.

message.description: The new user message to send. May be empty when custom_content carries attachments, form_value, or configuration_value.
message.example: What is the capital of France?

model.description: DIAL Core deployment name to use for completion

custom_content.description: Extra DIAL payload attached to the user message

newPath.description: New relative path of the renamed conversation

path.description: Full DIAL Core resource URL of the conversation to pin or unpin (matches `id` in `ConversationListItemDto`).

isPinned.description: Pass `true` to pin the conversation, `false` to unpin.

url.description: DIAL Core URL of the uploaded file

conversationId.description: Identifier of the conversation being rated

responseId.description: Identifier of the assistant response message being rated

modelId.description: Model deployment ID that produced the response

rate.description: Rating value — 1 (like/thumbs-up) or -1 (dislike/thumbs-down). DIAL Core adds this value to the message like count.

comment.description: Optional free-text comment from the user
